description:
## [1.3.0](https://github.com/WaggBR/Wagg13Patch_Morphe/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-10-16)

### ✨ New Features

* add Car Scanner and Pinterest patches, update Tinder and BuzzCast ([f6df240](https://github.com/WaggBR/Wagg13Patch_Morphe/commit/f6df24078ce53ae4c1ed8e1391412d0eee66764a))

patches.name: Hide home banner
patches.description: Hides the promotional banner carousel shown in the middle of the home live list.

patches.name: Hide join and follow messages
patches.description: Hides the "joined" and "followed the streamer" messages in the live chat and the join banner at the top.

patches.name: Hide live room cards
patches.description: Hides the rotating event/honor wall/daily recharge cards in the corner of live rooms.

patches.name: Hide live room notice
patches.description: Removes the 'healthy live streaming' notice shown in every live chat.

patches.name: Unlock SVIP
patches.description: Unlocks SVIP features, blocks purchase flow and Unity Ads.

patches.name: Story mention indicator
patches.description: Shows an "@N mention" pill in the story header when the story mentions someone. Tap it to list and open the mentioned profiles.

patches.name: Instants Mod
patches.description: Support for posting photos from the gallery to Instants via the gallery icon on the home screen.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Forces the Premium state source before it is recalculated and adds the mod author signature below the Bisbi version.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Disables AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, app open, rewarded) and the consent form.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Makes Car Scanner believe the Pro version was purchased (Google Play Billing).

patches.name: Trash bubble on pin long press
patches.description: Replace the WhatsApp bubble in the long-press menu of a saved PIN with atrash can that deletes the PIN.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces the premium entitlement in Native Camera. Premium status is stored locally and controls features such as the sub-40-Mbps bitrate cap. Compatible with v1.4 and v1.4.1 (PairIP was removed in v1.4.1).

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Spoof the Tinder package signature to fix push notifications (Enable to get notifications).

patches.name: Tinder Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes ads displayed between profiles in the swipe deck.

patches.name: Tinder Remove Upsells
patches.description: Remove sponsored messages in the chat and upsell pop-ups (Likes You, Boost).

patches.name: Tinder Unlimited Rewind
patches.description: Remove signature verification and enable Rewind locally.
